dedupe_keys.name: all polymer organic solar cells with nano to micron hierarchical morphology and large light receiving angle

description: All-polymer organic solar cells with nano-to-micron hierarchical morphology and large light receiving angle is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Materials Cloud. Distributed photovoltaics in living environment harvest the sunlight in different incident angles throughout the day. The development of planer solar cells with large light-receiving angle can reduce the requirements in installation form factor and is therefore urgently required. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Materials Cloud. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
